_note: THE FILES THE BUILD NEEDS AND THE REPOSITORY DOES NOT KEEP: the cut pictures of the site (_src/img/), of the topic pages (pages/pics/img/) and the film's music (_src/media/). Each is named by its place in site/, its address on the site, its size in bytes and its SHA-256. tools/fetch.py fetches them, the build stops when one is missing, and tools/fetch.py --record writes a file's new hash after a new cut.
